title: How to get FREE STUFF on your Birthday!
description: FOOD/ SNACKS/ SWEETS -Ikea- Sign up to be apart of the IKEA Family and they will send you a $10 off your purchase and a Free Birthday Meal (Choice of Meatball Entree with a DAIM cake or Blueberry Mouse) at the IKEA Restaurant. https://info.ikea-usa.com/family/?_ga=2.114000135.1481702457.1575070950-38706090.1571164759   They will send out the email the day before your birthday month and resend it throughout the month. -Krispy Kreme- Download the app and join the Krispy Kreme Rewards and enjoy a free doughnut of your choice and a freshly brewed cup of hot or iced coffee during your birthday month. They will also email you about your sweet treat on the first day of your birthday month.  - Brusters Icecream: Download the app or sign up online for the Bruster sweet rewards http://www.brusterssweetrewards.com/  They will send you an email and you must show the bar code in the Brusters app or give your phone number to the scooper. They have loaded a $3 reward to your account -First Watch: Join the sun e club https://www.firstwatch.com/eclub/ They will send you a complimentary breakfast, brunch or lunch entree in honor your birthday. They send me this offer on the first of my birthday month.  -Cold Stone Creamery:  Join the my cold stone club rewards and receive a BOGO ice cream on your account. https://my.spendgo.com/coldstone/index.html?_ga=2.147848691.579038998.1575073979-1422669313.1575073979#/signin -Jeremiahs Ice: Download the Jeremiahs Ice app and make an account with them and they will have you out in your birthday. Enjoy a free small menu item that will be loaded to your app during your a week before your birthday.  -Dunkin Donuts: Enroll in DD Perks Rewards program and enjoy a free beverage of any size during your birthday month. You will receive it in your email via barcode or you can download the app and scan it.  https://www.dunkindonuts.com/en/dd-perks - Starbucks: Download the Starbucks app and they will load a birthday reward on your birthday for any beverage or food of your choice.  -Waffle House: Sign up for the Waffle house regulars club and they will send you a free waffle coupon to print on your birthday. https://www.wafflehouse.com/regulars-club/ -Tropical Cafe: Download the app and make a tropical smoothie account and enjoy a $3 credit via the app.  -Firehouse: Download the app and make an account. They will send you a free Medium sub reward on your birthday through the app with no purchase necessary.  -Nothing Bundt Cakes: Sign up https://www.nothingbundtcakes.com/ for the eclub and recieve a free bundtlet for your birthday. They give you a few weeks to redeem.  -Auntie Annes- They will give you a free pretzel reward for your birthday via the app.   BEAUTY - CVS: Sign up for the CVS Pharmacy extracare  https://www.cvs.com/extracare/home?icid=cvsheader:extracare       and make sure your signed up for the BeautyClub. They sent me a birthday coupon for a free nail polish the first day of my birthday month. You have only 8 days to redeem.   -Ulta: Sign up to join the Ultamate rewards account and make sure you input your birthday. Remember to sign up for the rewards program and not the credit card. They will send you an email with a coupon on the first day of your birthday month. https://www.ulta.com/ulta/myaccount/register.jsp - Sephora: Sign up to be a Sephora insider and they will give you to choices to choose from during your birthday month. They do change out their birthday freebies throughout the year. They usually have a make up and a skin selection. Sign up with another email and score another $10 reward for just giving them your email. You are able to combine both coupons at the store for a $15 off $15 or more purchase.  - Dave & Busters: Join the Dave and Buster Rewards and they will send you a $10 game play with no purchase necessary when using your registers power card. They will send your an email with this coupon a week before your birthday - Pink/Victoria Secret: As an angel credit card holder they will send you a free panty coupon with no purchase necessary to your email the day before your birthday.
